headline: Brazil Moves Forward With Consumption Tax Rate and Fiscal Spending Vote
summary: Brazil's Chamber of Deputies took up President Lula's fiscal package following Senate passage, while the Senate evaluates an 11.3% rate for the new CBS federal consumption tax ahead of a December deadline.
why: Brazil is Latin America's largest economy, and its fiscal tax reform directly impacts corporate tax burdens and sovereign debt yields.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: The fiscal bill and consumption tax rate define Brazil's medium-term revenue and expenditure trajectory.
